title: Mixing: I Want My Love To Rest Tonight, I Felt Like Smashing My Face In A Clear Glass Window by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Two songs on Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe were mixed on 11 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘I Want My Love To Rest Tonight’ had been recorded on 23 and 26 October. It was first mixed on 5 November, and again on this date, but strings were added on 20 November and the song was finally mixed the following day.

‘I Felt Like Smashing My Face In A Clear Glass Window’ had been recorded on 1 November. The mixes created on this day were not used, however, as the final mix was made on 24 November.
